owner_request: Create mobile/lib/features/media/screens/upload_queue_screen.dart using Flutter Material3. Write a concise, production-ready screen (<180 lines) containing: an UploadTask model with fields (id, fileName, totalBytes, uploadedBytes, status: queued/uploading/paused/completed/failed), an UploadQueueScreen StatefulWidget with mock list state, a top Appbar with 'Pause All' / 'Resume All' actions, a summary row showing total active uploads, and a ListView.builder showing for each item: fileName, LinearProgressIndicator, percentage text, and trailing status icon or action button (pause/retry). Keep implementation compact so output easily fits within token limit.
